component.name: LiquidMon
component.summary: COSMIC panel applet for AIO liquid cooler monitoring and cooling control via liquidctl

description.p: LiquidMon is a COSMIC panel applet that monitors AIO liquid cooler temperature, fan duty, and pump duty through the liquidctl command-line tool, and can drive supported Corsair coolers with cooling presets or a manual fan duty and pump mode.

It shows live readings in the panel and opens a popup with sparklines, per-fan status, device selection, a configurable sample interval, and the cooling controls: four presets, manual mode, a curve preview, and an apply status line. Settings are written into the cooler itself, so they persist without LiquidMon running. Cooling control is limited to the hydro_platinum family (Corsair Hydro Pro XT, Platinum, and iCUE Elite RGB); other detected devices stay read-only.

Adds cooling control for Corsair Hydro Pro XT, Platinum, and iCUE Elite RGB coolers: four presets (Silent, Balanced, Performance, Max), manual duty and pump mode, and a curve preview in the popup. Settings are written into the cooler and persist without LiquidMon running. Control defaults to Unmanaged (no writes) until a mode is chosen, and automatic re-apply is limited to at most one write per applet run.

Reliability and accuracy fixes: readings now reflect the true polling cadence and recover from transient device-enumeration failures, liquidctl status parsing and error reporting are more robust, and sparklines handle out-of-range and non-finite samples cleanly. The udev-rules installer now pins the liquidctl rules to a tagged release for reproducible setup.
Popup now shows VU-meter equalizer charts for coolant temperature, pump duty, and fan duty. Animated fan and pump glyphs in popup headers. Panel button retains the gradient sparkline trend glyph.
Configurable sample interval (1–10 s slider, persisted via cosmic-config). Auto-detected device selection with persistent override dropdown.
Initial release. Panel button with live temperature, sparkline, fan duty, and pump duty. Popup with per-metric history and per-fan breakdown.
